name: Project Rebearth
detailed_description:
In Project Rebearth, you rebuild the world. The planet was devastated by a global collapse, and the only way for survivors to make it through was by hiding underground. Centuries passed, and now the surface appears habitable once more. It’s up to you, and all other players, to restore civilization. Play in a massive online multiplayer world where everyone shares the same exact 1:1 replica of planet Earth. Grow your town, trade with others for resources you can’t obtain on your own, face unexpected challenges, and uncover the lost history of the planet.

Start your adventure

  • Choose any spot on Earth to establish your settlement,

  • Build in a variety of biomes, each with its own resources and unique challenges,

  • Gather materials and manage your inventory to keep your inhabitants happy and your town thriving,

  • Discover lost knowledge to expand your capabilities and unlock new possibilities,

  • Make choices that have long-term consequences for your entire settlement,

  • Launch expeditions to search for ancient artifacts and piece together the true story of the world,

  • Travel across the globe to see how other players are rebuilding their own societies,

A 1:1 replica of Earth

Project Rebearth takes place on a full-scale, 1:1 replica of our beloved planet. You decide whether to start your settlement in scorching deserts, frozen polar regions, or lush temperate forests. Each real-world location has its own flora, fauna, building materials, natural resources, and specialized production chains.

The world is your playground

Explore familiar and unfamiliar corners of the Earth. Get inspired by the creativity of other players, and export any location as a high-resolution map. Perfect for map-making or integrating into offline adventures like TTRPGs.

The world never sleeps

Project Rebearth is a relaxed, long-term experience—not meant to be rushed through in a weekend. Your farms keep growing potatoes, your woodcutters keep producing lumber, even while you’re offline. Play at your own pace, whenever it suits you.

Uncover the mystery

Send out expeditions to discover artifacts that hold the secrets of a forgotten past. How did the world end up the way it is now? Can you, together with other players, unravel the story of Project Rebearth?
